_doc: Classification table for gen-portal-definitions.mjs. Source: proposals MCP_PORTAL_ESTATE.md v0.1 section 5 (portal audiences) plus live evidence GET 2026-11-23. Servers not covered by a section 5 rule are listed under unclassified with a reason and are never placed.

mirror_reasons.chode: Code-mode portal (live GET 2026-11-23: code_mode default_on, description "Chitty Code Mode", 59 servers); D6 exception: may carry every placed server.
mirror_reasons.chittymcp-vm: Headless service-access portal (live GET 2026-11-23: code_mode opt_in, description "Service Access - Headless", 58 servers); mirrors chitty-mcp membership by design (reason recorded).

chitty-mcp.audience: operator core: ChittyOS control-plane agents plus legal/finance agents (matter isolation enforced by the agents)

chittycomms.description: Messaging MCP, Quo, imessage, twillio, and others coming soon

chode.audience: code-mode connector (claude.ai Chitty Code-Mode); carries every placed server

chittymcp-vm.audience: headless service access; mirror of chitty-mcp membership

groups.reason: Legal/finance agent: chitty-mcp only; matter isolation is enforced by the agent, not portal placement (section 5)

unclassified.buyflow: Zero-tool error server; no section 5 rule covers it.
unclassified.bridge-consent: Zero-tool error server; no section 5 rule covers it.
unclassified.availability: Zero-tool error server; no section 5 rule covers it.
unclassified.cloudeflare-codemode: No section 5 rule covers it; stale third-party codemode upstream (mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp).
unclassified.cf-dns: Stale third-party upstream (snapshot status stale); left for an operator decision even though the cf-* rule would otherwise place it.
unclassified.google: Duplicate of gws (shares upstream agent.chitty.cc/google/mcp), 0 portals, oauth, waiting; operator decides whether to retire it.
unclassified.secrets: Bearer-auth server on secrets.chitty.cc with no section 5 rule covering it; credential surface, so placement is an operator decision.
